narrative_summary: Q1 2026 earnings beat ($308M revenue, up from ~$65M at March 2024 IPO) with stronger Q2 outlook reinforces near-term Scorpio ramp catalyst. Scorpio X-Series 320-lane Smart Fabric Switch and expanded Scorpio P-Series PCIe-6 (32-320 lane configs) launched. Multi-customer shipments expected H2 2026; broader volume ramps 2027. RBC expects ALAB to benefit from Amazon-Anthropic deal via Scorpio X switches ramping for Trainium3 racks in Q3. Evercore ISI flagged AI inference as growing focus by late 2026. Q1 already reported (May), so next earnings would be Q2 (~late July/early Aug 2026).
